frontmatter.title: V14.2 General Data Protection
when_to_use: transmitting or storing sensitive data (PII, payment info, credentials)
controlling what sensitive data is returned in API responses
preventing sensitive data from leaking into URLs, logs, or caches
implementing data retention or deletion policies
threats: sensitive data exposure in logs or URLs
excessive data returned in API responses
stale sensitive data retained beyond need
frontmatter.summary: Requirements for protecting sensitive data from unauthorized access, leakage, and excessive exposure.
